title: Besan Barfi
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.romanUrdu: -Olper’s Tarrka Desi Ghee 1 Cup
-Baisan (Gram flour) sifted 2 & ½ Cups
-Sooji (Semolina) 3 tbs

steps.instruction: -Yellow food color few drops or as required
steps.romanUrdu: -Yellow food color few drops or as required
-Sugar 1 & ½ Cup
-Water 1 & ½ Cup
-Kewra essence ½ tsp
-Elaichi powder (Cardamom powder) 1 tsp
-Pista (Pistachios) sliced
-Badam (Almonds) sliced

steps.instruction: -In a wok,add desi ghee & let it melt.
steps.romanUrdu: -Karahi mein desi ghee dal ker melt ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add gram flour,semolina,mix well & ghee roast baisan on low flame while mixing continuously (10-12 minutes),continue mixing & cooking until its until fragrant & smooth (10-12 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: -Baisan aur sooji dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur musalsal mix kertay hoye halki ancch per baisan ko ghee roast ker lein (10-12 minutes),musalsal mix kertay hoye khushbu anay aur smooth ho janay tak paka lein (10-12 minutes).

steps.instruction: -Spray water to check,if bubbles appear than it is done.
steps.romanUrdu: -Check kernay kliya pani ka spray karein,agar bubbles bun jayein tou yeh tayyar hai.

steps.instruction: -Add yellow food color,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Yellow food color dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a saucepan,add sugar,water & mix well,bring it to boil & cook until one string consistency (8-10 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: -Saucepan mein cheeni aur pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ubal anay ka bad one string consistency anay tak paka lein (8-10 minutes).

steps.instruction: -Add kewra essence,cardamom powder,mix well & pour hot sugar syrup in warm gram flour mixture & mix continuously until it becomes thick & leaves the sides of pot.
steps.romanUrdu: -Kewra water aur elaichi powder dal ke ache tarhan mix karein aur garam sheeray ko neem garam baisan ka mixture mein dal dein,garha aur pot ki sides chornay tak musalsal mix kertay rahein.

steps.instruction: -Transfer the mixture on greased mold & spread evenly.
steps.romanUrdu: -Mixture ko greased mold mein dal ker evenly pheela lein.
-Pista aur badam dal ker gently press ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Let it cool for 2 hours or until set.
steps.romanUrdu: -2 hours ya set ho janay tak thanda ker lein.
-Desired pieces mein cut ker ka serve karein.
